name: Auto_Sand_L2

model.horizontalControl: full speed or release; no horizontal overspeed
model.headCollisionPolicy: upward velocity becomes zero at contact; gravity starts the falling arc at the clipped height

validation.jumpArcAudit: 44 adjacent upward jumps PASS (7-high/11-wide arc, full3x2body, clipped head-hit falls)
validation.manualPlatform1: eleven original row33 tiles preserved; row34 support PASS
validation.wallConnections: six left, eight right; intervals2–5 platforms PASS
validation.noStraightDescentLane: every3-wide vertical lane meets a left baffle PASS
validation.ceilingProfile: 4-row cap plus mostly3, some4, central5 rows PASS
validation.fullLengthEnemyPatrols: all five enemies on13-tile platforms PASS
validation.stationarySpacing: >=3 horizontal empty columns OR>=4 vertical empty rows PASS

limitations: Sampled geometry validation is not Android physics simulation.
Jump audit allows edge launch/landing with at least0.5tile support and horizontal release; head hits zero vertical velocity and shorten the arc.
Moving platforms are optional alternatives; fixed ledges provide the validated route.
Worm attacks, enemy behavior, lift boarding and pacing require playtesting.
